title: Towards Inclusive Toxic Content Moderation: Addressing Vulnerabilities to Adversarial Attacks in Toxicity Classifiers Tackling LLM-generated Content

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's adversarial vulnerability and changes in classification accuracy using mechanistic interpretability (activation patching of attention heads) on texts mentioning different racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, White, Asian, Latino, Chinese).

Evaluating the model's adversarial vulnerability and changes in classification accuracy using mechanistic interpretability (activation patching of attention heads) on texts mentioning different genders (e.g., female, male, women).

Evaluating the model's adversarial vulnerability and changes in classification accuracy using mechanistic interpretability (activation patching of attention heads) on texts mentioning religious affiliations (e.g., Christian, Jewish, Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, Atheist).

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender Identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's adversarial vulnerability and changes in classification accuracy using mechanistic interpretability (activation patching of attention heads) on texts mentioning sexual orientations and gender identities (e.g., heterosexual, homosexual, bisexual, transgender, LGBTQ).

Evaluating the model's adversarial vulnerability and changes in classification accuracy using mechanistic interpretability (activation patching of attention heads) on texts mentioning physical disabilities and mental illnesses.

Evaluating the model's adversarial vulnerability and changes in classification accuracy using mechanistic interpretability (activation patching of attention heads) on texts mentioning specific nationalities or regions (e.g., Mexican, Middle East).
